subject: ‘Still under pressure’: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese confirms fuel excise cut extension
posts: A temporary shield against global volatility. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese confirms fuel excise cut extension. Evidence: Cost of living, fuel stability, government intervention. #AusPol #Economy

Verdict: PASS — The Path of Redemption. The policy acknowledges the systemic pressure and provides tangible, albeit limited, relief.
Anthony Albanese has extended the fuel excise cut for one month, saving drivers 16 cents per litre, as the government works to ensure fuel supply stability.

The Poison:
The relief is temporary and does not address the underlying structural causes of high fuel prices.

This is a WHAT vs WHY error. They address the WHAT (price at the pump) but struggle with the WHY (global supply chain instability).
